title: 2.8 Colors
unit_title: Unit 2: Places, Things, Numbers and Colors
unit_outcome: Name places and things with un/una and el/la, count them, and say their color and size with the right ending.
goal: Name six colors and say what color something is; the color matches the thing: El autobús es rojo. La bicicleta es azul.
grammar_function: ¿De qué color es? El/La + noun + es + color (-o or -a to match).
